owner_creation.analysis: FILE:src/safe_core/coordinate.rs: SourceOffset, LogicalLine and display/index wrappers own checked integer values; RetainedRange owns two offsets and explicitly owns no file or backing bytes.

limitations: Checked coordinates are not a proof of live input identity; future caller integration must validate owner generation and range freshness.
